There's a non-zero chance Drew Lock implodes and ends the "QB controversy" by the bye week.

He won't surprise teams anymore. The more backup QBs play, the more they get exposed. That's why they're backups. We see this every year: Tanner Mckee was "reliable" until he wasn't.

Joe Milton will be the fourth different Eagles’ QB to throw a pass this season: 

🏈Jalen Hurts (blood clots)
🏈Andy Dalton (released)
🏈Tanner McKee (0-3 as starter)
🏈Joe Milton

Philly is 2-6 and has lost six straight.

While I don't think it's fair to blame Tanner McKee for the failings of the offense over the last few games, I do think it's clear he's shown that his ceiling just isn't very high. 

Not all 6th Rd picks turn out to be Tom Brady... 🤷 #Eagles #GoBirds
